connector.name: Maacgo MCP
connector.registryDescription: Taiwan SMS MCP server. Send from Claude / Cursor / Windsurf, NCC-compliant, NT$50 free trial.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jinhsueh account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: MAACGO_API_KEY
env.description: MAAC Go API key from https://sms.cresclab.com/app.html#transactional. Use sk_test_... while developing, sk_live_... for real sends.

env.name: MAACGO_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the REST base URL (default https://sms.cresclab.com/api). Only set this for staging or self-host deployments.
